scripts.sync:android: bun run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: bun run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew clean :app:assembleDebug
scripts.android:install: bun run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew clean :app:installDebug
scripts.android:release:apk: bun run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew clean :app:assembleRelease
scripts.android:release:aab: bun run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew clean :app:bundleRelease
